name: air-cli
description: Agentic Information Retrieval - Take back control of your information diet. Use AI agents + Playwright to curate web content based on YOUR preferences, not Big Tech's algorithms.

scripts.build:bun: mkdir -p bin && bun build src/index.ts --compile --outfile bin/air --external electron --external chromium-bidi
scripts.build:node: mkdir -p bin && echo '#!/usr/bin/env bash' > bin/air && echo 'DIR="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")" && pwd)"' >> bin/air && echo 'exec node "$DIR/../dist/src/index.js" "$@"' >> bin/air && chmod +x bin/air
scripts.build:windows: mkdir -p bin && bun run build:ts && pkg dist/src/index.js --targets node18-win-x64 --output bin/air.exe
scripts.build:linux: mkdir -p bin && bun run build:ts && pkg dist/src/index.js --targets node18-linux-x64 --output bin/air
scripts.build:all: mkdir -p bin && bun run build:ts && pkg dist/src/index.js --targets node18-macos-arm64,node18-win-x64,node18-linux-x64 --output bin/air
scripts.install:local: bun run build && mkdir -p ~/.local/bin && cp bin/air ~/.local/bin/
scripts.test:ci: AIR_CLI_HEADLESS=true PORT=19222 bun run test:shard:capture && sleep 2 && bun run test:shard:interaction && sleep 2 && bun run test:shard:lib
scripts.test:shard:capture: AIR_CLI_HEADLESS=true PORT=19222 bun test --preload ./src/test-utils/global-setup.ts --max-concurrency=1 --bail=5 --timeout 30000 src/yargs/commands/capture; pkill -9 -f 'Chrome.*19222' 2>/dev/null || true
scripts.test:shard:interaction: AIR_CLI_HEADLESS=true PORT=19222 bun test --preload ./src/test-utils/global-setup.ts --max-concurrency=1 --bail=5 --timeout 30000 src/yargs/commands/interaction; pkill -9 -f 'Chrome.*19222' 2>/dev/null || true
scripts.test:shard:advanced: AIR_CLI_HEADLESS=true PORT=19222 bun test --preload ./src/test-utils/global-setup.ts --max-concurrency=1 --bail=5 --timeout 30000 src/yargs/commands/advanced; pkill -9 -f 'Chrome.*19222' 2>/dev/null || true
scripts.test:shard:navigation: AIR_CLI_HEADLESS=true PORT=19222 bun test --preload ./src/test-utils/global-setup.ts --max-concurrency=1 --bail=5 --timeout 30000 src/yargs/commands/navigation src/yargs/commands/utility; pkill -9 -f 'Chrome.*19222' 2>/dev/null || true
scripts.test:shard:lib: AIR_CLI_HEADLESS=true PORT=19222 bun test --preload ./src/test-utils/global-setup.ts --max-concurrency=1 --bail=5 --timeout 30000 src/lib src/yargs/__tests__ src/yargs/lib src/yargs/middleware; pkill -9 -f 'Chrome.*19222' 2>/dev/null || true
scripts.ci: bun run typecheck && bun run lint && bun run format:check && bun run test:coverage
